qualificationQuestions: Are you actively accepting new weddings, and which upcoming couples have confirmed or flexible dates?
How many ceremony/reception guests are expected, and how many will travel to Grenada rather than attend locally?
Do you source accommodation and room blocks, or does the couple or a travel adviser handle this separately?
Who approves the hotel and budget, signs the event and accommodation agreements, and pays deposits and final balances?
What room categories, arrival/departure dates, stay lengths and booking arrangements are needed?
Is the event within the resort’s advertised 35-guest wedding scope, and what reception layout and weather backup are required?
Which catering, rehearsal dinner, private dining, spa and honeymoon elements are required beyond existing package inclusions?
Will the resort accept an external planner and preferred suppliers, and what access charges, insurance, vendor rules and commercial terms apply?
What mobility/accessibility, dietary, child-attendance, outside-guest and transport requirements must the resort confirm?
snapshot.recommendedNextStep: Send a personalized B2B introduction to Khadine at plan@beautifulweddingsgrenada.com, with one follow-up via the published BWG WhatsApp route if appropriate. Offer an exploratory site visit with the resort’s wedding team for intimate beach/garden weddings, explaining that availability, external-planner collaboration and commercial terms require confirmation. Ask whether she has an actual couple with dates and accommodation needs before quoting or holding inventory. Internally, ask Elisabeth to refer the enquiry to the wedding/group-sales decision-maker. Do not approach historical couples as current leads, imply an existing partnership, or promise referral fees or room blocks.
